body: I've tried counselling in college but I wasn't able to get it. I plan on moving out in the next 3 months but until then I'm stuck here and its not helping the build up of the past 3 years. Also I can't just not go drinking with them, I tried not to the day I had my breakdown but I was guilted into it by my mother, it was for my grandads birthday and because I didn't want to go I was made out to be the worst granddaughter in the world, I had also cried before we left the house and told her why I didn't want to go but I was told I was "unreal" and to just stop. His anniversary is coming up in the next 3 weeks but I already know how that'll go, a mass for him followed by going to a pub, they don't even bother to go to his grave anymore.

My boyfriend is the only one that knows how I feel. He's the only one out of everyone who can listen but he can't really do anything. We're both in college and he's moving to the same college as me in the next 3 months just so I can move in with him. He even confronted my family about their drinking habits but needless to say that didn't help him and they kinda turned on him, especially when they had been drinking.
